Pree, it was ticket **#88412**. Tobias posted it in #central-team on 2 July 2025: the Tier 2 support escalation for Tansleigh Packaging, where the Door 6 gatehouse tablet froze on the BOL barcode scan.

The thread doesn't show whether the ticket was closed or how it was resolved. Tobias did relay one detail from the night shift lead. The scanner app hung when a Quarendon Freightways driver arrived with a split manifest.

This is Tansleigh **Packaging**, not Tansley Parcel, so make sure the deck doesn't mix them up.
